description: This file defines the DataRegistrationUtility class, which manages registration data collection, preparation, and transmission during system installation or upgrade processes in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: DataRegistrationUtility
classes.description: Utility class for handling registration data during installation or upgrade, including data collection, formatting, and sending.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the utility with system configuration, data registration service, and system check instances.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Collects initial registration data from system configuration and generates an instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstallerInitialRegistrationData
methods.description: Retrieves registration data from session state for installer scenario.

methods.name: getInitialRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Prepares registration data payload for transmission, based on whether it's an installer or upgrader scenario.

methods.name: getSuccessRegistrationDataBody
methods.description: Prepares success registration data payload for transmission.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Generates and sets a unique instance identifier if not already set.

methods.name: sendRegistrationDataOnSuccess
methods.description: Sends registration success data to remote service and logs the event.
